北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京今天有点冷哦，出门记得多穿点，注意保暖。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is chilly today. Remember to layer up and stay warm!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阳光正好，气温宜人，适合户外走走。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has pleasant sunshine. It's a great day for an outdoor stroll!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴好，体感舒适。别忘了享受这美好的天气！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is clear and comfortable. Don't forget to enjoy the lovely weather!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州温暖舒适，湿度稍高。记得适时补充水分哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is warm and comfy, a bit humid. Stay hydrated!
广州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳天气真好，温暖又舒适，很适合出门活动！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen's weather is lovely, warm and comfortable. Perfect for outdoor activities!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阳光明媚，体感舒适。不妨出去透透气！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny and comfortable. Why not get some fresh air?

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阳光正好，气温适中，出门走走很惬意。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has pleasant sunshine and moderate temps. Enjoy a comfortable walk!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，体感微凉。出门记得带把伞，有备无患。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and cool. Remember to bring an umbrella, just in case.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有雾，能见度低。驾车慢行，注意交通安全哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy with low visibility. Drive carefully and stay safe!
武汉.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安天气阴沉，气温有点低。多喝热水，注意保暖。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and cool. Drink more hot water and keep warm.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有霾，出门佩戴口罩，保护呼吸道健康。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is hazy. Wear a mask when going out for respiratory protection.
重庆.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨天寒地冻，体感零下 26℃！请务必全副武装，注意防寒。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is extremely cold, feels like -26℃! Bundle up completely to stay warm.
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -26℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳非常冷，体感零下 21℃。出门多穿衣服，小心着凉。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is very cold, feels like -21℃. Wear more clothes to avoid catching a cold.
沈阳.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -21℃ | 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光正好，气温宜人。快去感受春城魅力吧！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming has lovely sunshine and pleasant temps. Enjoy the charm of the Spring City!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门风力较大，体感微凉。注意防风，多添衣。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is a bit windy and cool. Take care against wind and add layers.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有风，体感较冷。记得穿上防风外套，别冻着了。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is windy and feels cold. Wear a windproof jacket to stay warm.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感低于冰点。注意保暖，小心感冒。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and feels below freezing. Keep warm and avoid catching a cold.
